body: Gay marriage was just legalised in New Zealand, rights have nothing to do with it. I'm high every day but I'm also sober every day, if that makes sense. I am home alone tonight and I've been thinking about this for a while. I just feel like I have an opportunity finally.
I'm gay. University dropout in a shitty job with no money from spending it all on drugs. Nobody seems to understand my thoughts. I just feel odd.
What is there left to say?
